item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 19/Sep/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine and very hot weather to southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, winds will be weak over Guangdong. Showers triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. A weak northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southeastern China towards the weekend. It will be cloudier with a few showers over the region. A broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the vicinity of the central part of the South China Sea and the Philippines over the weekend and early next week.
